mapper.select: /* BmsLocalInspectResultMapper.selectBmsOutByBlNo : 반출 상세 조회 */ SELECT * FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE BL_NO = #{blNo} AND OUT_CLASS ='61' AND OUT_APPROVAL_NO ='04002001'

/* BmsLocalInspectResultMapper.selectTicData : 특송창고 검사결과및 이고반입 입고 조회 */ SELECT * FROM TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT inspectRst LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IN_NO AS BMS_IN_NO ,CT ,OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_CLASS = '21' AND IN_APPROVAL_NO = '04002001' ) tbi ON inspectRst.IN_NO = tbi.BMS_IN_NO WHERE inspectRst.BL_NO = #{blNo} AND inspectRst.TIC_OUT_SCAN_USER_ID <> ''
mapper.update: /* BmsLocalInspectResultMapper.updateScanDateBmsOutPlan : 반출승인 출고SCAN날짜 업데이트 */ UPDATE TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN SET OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME = GETDATE(), UPDATE_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, UPDATE_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() WHERE OUT_PLAN_NO = #{outPlanNo}
mapper.select:
/* BmsLocalInspectResultMapper.selectInspectResultFilteredByCodeGroup : MBL번호와 검사코드 그룹으로 필터링된 검사결과들을 조회 */
SELECT IN_NO , BL_NO , TCD.NAME_DEFAULT , CASE WHEN SE_INSPECTION_FINISH_USER_ID <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION_YN , 'SE' AS INSPECTION_KEYWORD , SE_INSPECTION_CODE , XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE FROM TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL TCD ON TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = TCD.CODE AND TCD.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' WHERE CARRYIN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()), 23) AND CARRYIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) AND MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND SE_INSPECTION_CODE <> ''
UNION ALL
SELECT IN_NO , BL_NO , TCD.NAME_DEFAULT , CASE WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_FINISH_USER_ID <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION_YN , 'XRAY' AS INSPECTION_KEYWORD , SE_INSPECTION_CODE , XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE FROM TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL TCD ON TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = TCD.CODE AND TCD.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' WHERE CARRYIN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()), 23) AND CARRYIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) AND MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE <> ''
SELECT IN_NO , BL_NO , TCD.NAME_DEFAULT , CASE WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE_FINISH_USER_ID <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION_YN , 'TYPE' AS INSPECTION_KEYWORD , INSPECTION_TYPE , INSPECTION_TYPE_A , INSPECTION_TYPE_B FROM TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL TCD ON TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT.INSPECTION_TYPE = TCD.CODE AND TCD.GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' WHERE CARRYIN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()), 23) AND CARRYIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) AND MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND INSPECTION_TYPE <> ''
UNION ALL
SELECT IN_NO , BL_NO , TCD.NAME_DEFAULT , CASE WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE_A_FINISH_USER_ID <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION_YN , 'TYPE_A' AS INSPECTION_KEYWORD , INSPECTION_TYPE , INSPECTION_TYPE_A , INSPECTION_TYPE_B FROM TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL TCD ON TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT.INSPECTION_TYPE_A = TCD.CODE AND TCD.GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' WHERE CARRYIN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()), 23) AND CARRYIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) AND MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND INSPECTION_TYPE_A <> ''
UNION ALL
SELECT IN_NO , BL_NO , TCD.NAME_DEFAULT , CASE WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE_B_FINISH_USER_ID <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION_YN , 'TYPE_B' AS INSPECTION_KEYWORD , INSPECTION_TYPE , INSPECTION_TYPE_A , INSPECTION_TYPE_B FROM TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL TCD ON TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT.INSPECTION_TYPE_B = TCD.CODE AND TCD.GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' WHERE CARRYIN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()), 23) AND CARRYIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) AND MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND INSPECTION_TYPE_B <> ''
SELECT IN_NO , BL_NO , TCD.NAME_DEFAULT , CASE WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_FINISH_USER_ID <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION_YN , 'PALN5EM' AS INSPECTION_KEYWORD , PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE FROM TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL TCD ON TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = TCD.CODE AND TCD.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' WHERE CARRYIN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()), 23) AND CARRYIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) AND MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE <> ''
mapper.update:
/* BmsLocalInspectResultMapper.updateInspectResultByInspectionKeyword : 검사코드완료 업데이트 */
UPDATE TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT SET
SE_INSPECTION_FINISH_USER_ID = #{finishUserId}, SE_INSPECTION_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE()
XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_FINISH_USER_ID = #{finishUserId}, XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE()
INSPECTION_TYPE_FINISH_USER_ID = #{finishUserId}, INSPECTION_TYPE_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE()
INSPECTION_TYPE_A_FINISH_USER_ID = #{finishUserId}, INSPECTION_TYPE_A_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE()
INSPECTION_TYPE_B_FINISH_USER_ID = #{finishUserId}, INSPECTION_TYPE_B_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE()
PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_FINISH_USER_ID = #{finishUserId}, PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE()
WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo}
